thread:
eva: noticing odd token tallies for resumed streams that get truncated mid-toolcall. console shows both provisional toolcall tokens and final truncated confirmed tokens.

mike: do you have a minimal trace?

eva: yep: 
```
2026-05-05T09:40:01Z STREAM_START s=zz1 tokens=2 provisional=true route=r1
2026-05-05T09:40:01Z ROUTE_HANDOFF s=zz1 to=node-c provisional=true fp=fpA
2026-05-05T09:40:02Z NODE_TOOLCALL s=zz1 tool=suffix tokens=10 provisional=true fp=fpA
2026-05-05T09:40:02Z CLIENT_ABORT s=zz1 reason=truncation
2026-05-05T09:40:03Z LEDGER_COMMIT s=zz1 confirmed_tokens=5
```

lina: so provisional counted 12 then confirmed 5. overlap of 7 incorrectly visible.

mike: this is similar to our retry/hand-off races but with truncation causing partial confirmations.

eva: right. customers see provisional spike then a smaller confirmed number, the net is wrong until cleanup. support tickets spike.

lina: UX idea: show "provisional (pending reconciliation)" and in details show provisional events with fp and last seen state. help support interpret.

mike: backend fix options: 1) make ledger finalizer subtract provisional entries when confirmed tokens < provisional for same fp; 2) emit a compensating provisional-reversal event from node on client abort.

eva: I prefer finalizer reconciliation because nodes can be flaky on abort. finalizer has full view. but it needs stable keys (session+fp+seq).

mike: agree. finalizer change needs a migration plan and a feature flag. recommend console-first: visualize discrepancies, then flip opt-in dedupe, then default.

ops-bot: Created INF-3010: truncation overlap reconciliation design (assignee: lina). https://redwood.internal/INF-3010

lina: will draft short doc with sequence diagrams and proposed metric panels ("reconciled_tokens", "provisional_delta").
eva: I'll coordinate with support to add an explanation snippet.
mike: keep me posted, I can help with atomicity in the finalizer. :thumbsup:
